#!/usr/bin/env bash
# v1-experiments.sh — Claude V1 독립 적대 검증 실험 (HS-00.01). 원본 저장소는 읽기만 한다.
# 파괴·변이는 mkdtemp 로 만든 clone 사본($CLONE)에서만 수행한다.
set -u
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_ASKPASS
ORIG="$1"; CLONE="$2"; PART="${3:-all}"
ACC="bash scripts/verify/run-acceptance.sh scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh"
MUT="bash scripts/verify/run-acceptance.sh scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh"
FIX="docs/engineering/humansearch-kickoff-ledger-verdict-0000-00-00.md"
FILES=".github/workflows/verify.yml docs/sot/verification-commands.md docs/engineering/humansearch-branch-disposition-2026-09-07.md docs/engineering/history/resume-evidence-supabase-archive-goal-2026-08-17.md docs/engineering/history/resume-evidence-supabase-implementation-prompt-2026-08-17.md docs/engineering/goal-prompts/humansearch-journey-kickoff-2026-09-07.md scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py docs/engineering/humansearch-hs0001-goal-2026-09-10.md"

ts() { date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'; }
hdr() { printf '\n##### [%s] %s\n' "$(ts)" "$1"; }
run() { # run <label> <cmd...> ; prints cmd, rc, full output
  local label="$1"; shift
  printf -- '--- CMD(%s) @%s: %s\n' "$label" "$(ts)" "$*"
  local rc=0; local out; out=$("$@" 2>&1) || rc=$?
  printf '%s\n--- RC(%s)=%d\n' "$out" "$label" "$rc"
  return 0
}
reset_clone() {
  git -C "$CLONE" checkout -q -- . && git -C "$CLONE" clean -qfd
  git -C "$CLONE" worktree prune
}
fixture() { # $1 = first line
  printf '%s\n\n시험대 전용 합성 판정 문서(V1 실험).\n' "$1" > "$CLONE/$FIX"
}
show_diff() { git -C "$CLONE" --no-pager diff --stat; git -C "$CLONE" --no-pager diff; git -C "$CLONE" status --porcelain; }

if [ "$PART" = "setup" ]; then
  hdr "SETUP: 원본 작업트리 파일을 clone 으로 복사해 기준 커밋을 만든다"
  cd "$CLONE" || exit 1
  git checkout -q 06110d9355ae352da58e4ee7e4e2551962cda7d4
  for f in $FILES; do mkdir -p "$(dirname "$f")"; cp "$ORIG/$f" "$f"; done
  git add -A
  git -c user.name=v1 -c user.email=v1@local commit -q -m "V1 시험대 기준(원본 작업트리 사본)"
  run "clone-head" git rev-parse HEAD
  run "clone-sha256" shasum -a 256 $FILES
  exit 0
fi

cd "$CLONE" || exit 1

if [ "$PART" = "all" ] || [ "$PART" = "A" ]; then
  hdr "E0 원본(읽기 전용) — 판정 문서 없는 현재 상태의 본 검사"
  ( cd "$ORIG" && run "E0-orig-acceptance" $ACC )
  ( cd "$ORIG" && run "E0-orig-list-steps-29-30" bash -c 'python3 scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py .github/workflows/verify.yml | sed -n "29,30p"; echo "steps=$(python3 scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py .github/workflows/verify.yml | wc -l | tr -d " ")"' )
  ( cd "$ORIG" && run "E0-orig-prepush-glob" bash -c "find . -maxdepth 2 \\( -name 'verify.sh' -o -name 'acceptance-*.sh' \\) -not -path './worktrees/*' -not -path './.git/*' | LC_ALL=C sort | grep -n 'hs-kickoff'" )
  ( cd "$ORIG" && run "E0-orig-ci-step-integrity" bash scripts/verify/check-ci-step-integrity.sh )

  hdr "E1 정상 대조군(clone) — 첫 줄 'VERDICT: FAIL' 합성 판정 문서로 12/12, 변이 37/37"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: FAIL"
  run "E1-acceptance-FAILdoc" $ACC
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  run "E1-acceptance-PASSdoc" $ACC
  run "E1-mutations" $MUT
fi

if [ "$PART" = "all" ] || [ "$PART" = "B" ]; then
  hdr "E2 항상 허용 — failc 를 PASS 출력으로 바꾼다 (판정 문서 없이도 exit 0 이어야 '항상 허용')"
  reset_clone
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path("scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh"); s=p.read_text()
old='failc() { echo "FAIL: $1"; checked=$((checked+1)); fail=1; }'
assert s.count(old)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(old,'failc() { echo "PASS: $1"; checked=$((checked+1)); }'))
PY
  show_diff
  run "E2-acceptance-no-verdict" $ACC
  run "E2-mutations" $MUT

  hdr "E3 항상 거부 — pass 를 FAIL 로 바꾼다"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path("scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh"); s=p.read_text()
old='pass() { echo "PASS: $1"; checked=$((checked+1)); }'
assert s.count(old)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(old,'pass() { echo "FAIL: $1"; checked=$((checked+1)); fail=1; }'))
PY
  show_diff
  run "E3-acceptance" $ACC
  run "E3-mutations" $MUT
fi

if [ "$PART" = "all" ] || [ "$PART" = "C" ]; then
  hdr "E4a 핵심 검사 생략 — 항목 12(판정 문서)를 무조건 PASS 로 바꾼다 (CHECKED 12 유지)"
  reset_clone
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,re
p=pathlib.Path("scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh"); s=p.read_text()
start=s.index("# 12 Codex V2 판정 문서"); end=s.index('echo "CHECKED: $checked"')
new='# 12 Codex V2 판정 문서\npass "판정 문서 (생략됨)"\n\n'
p.write_text(s[:start]+new+s[end:])
PY
  show_diff
  run "E4a-acceptance-no-verdict" $ACC
  run "E4a-mutations" $MUT

  hdr "E4b 핵심 검사 생략 — list-workflow-steps 의 약화 키 목록을 비운다"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  sed -i '' 's/^WEAK_KEYS = ("if", "continue-on-error")$/WEAK_KEYS = ()/' scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py
  show_diff
  run "E4b-mutations" $MUT
fi

if [ "$PART" = "all" ] || [ "$PART" = "D" ]; then
  hdr "E5a 신규 반례 — hs-kickoff 스텝에 step 수준 shell 키(bash -c \"true\" {0})"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(".github/workflows/verify.yml"); s=p.read_text()
old="        run: bash scripts/verify/run-acceptance.sh scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh"
assert s.count(old)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, '        shell: bash -c "true" {0}\n'+old))
PY
  show_diff
  run "E5a-acceptance" $ACC
  run "E5a-ci-step-integrity" bash scripts/verify/check-ci-step-integrity.sh
  run "E5a-list-steps-29" bash -c 'python3 scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py .github/workflows/verify.yml | sed -n 29p'
  # GitHub 는 custom shell 을 `<shell 문자열의 {0} 를 스크립트 경로로 치환>` 으로 실행한다. 로컬 재현:
  printf 'bash scripts/verify/run-acceptance.sh scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh\n' > /tmp/v1-step-script.sh
  run "E5a-semantic-local" bash -c 'bash -c "true" /tmp/v1-step-script.sh; echo "step-exit=$?"; echo "(본 검사 출력이 위에 한 줄도 없으면 검사가 실행되지 않은 것)"'

  hdr "E5b 신규 반례 — 워크플로 수준 defaults.run.shell: cat"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(".github/workflows/verify.yml"); s=p.read_text()
old="jobs:\n"
assert s.count(old)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, "defaults:\n  run:\n    shell: cat\n\n"+old,1))
PY
  show_diff
  run "E5b-acceptance" $ACC
  run "E5b-ci-step-integrity" bash scripts/verify/check-ci-step-integrity.sh

  hdr "E5f 신규 반례 — 스텝 env 의 BASH_ENV 로 검사 전 종료"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  printf 'exit 0\n' > scripts/v1-bait-env.sh
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(".github/workflows/verify.yml"); s=p.read_text()
old="        run: bash scripts/verify/run-acceptance.sh scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh"
assert s.count(old)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, '        env:\n          BASH_ENV: scripts/v1-bait-env.sh\n'+old))
PY
  show_diff
  run "E5f-acceptance" $ACC
  run "E5f-ci-step-integrity" bash scripts/verify/check-ci-step-integrity.sh
  run "E5f-semantic-local" bash -c 'BASH_ENV=scripts/v1-bait-env.sh bash -e /tmp/v1-step-script.sh; echo "step-exit=$?"'

  hdr "E5c HS-00.04 부채 — on.push.branches 를 매치 불가로 바꾼다"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(".github/workflows/verify.yml"); s=p.read_text()
old='    branches: ["**"]\n  pull_request:\n'
assert s.count(old)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, '    branches: ["never-matches-anything"]\n'))
PY
  show_diff
  run "E5c-acceptance" $ACC
  run "E5c-ci-step-integrity" bash scripts/verify/check-ci-step-integrity.sh

  hdr "E5d 경계 — 처분표 대상 'PR #13' 을 'PR #131' 로 바꾼다 (부분문자열 일치)"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path("docs/engineering/humansearch-branch-disposition-2026-09-07.md"); s=p.read_text()
old="| 1 | PR #13 `task/humansearch-g3-portal-constants`"
assert s.count(old)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(old,"| 1 | PR #131 `task/humansearch-g3-portal-constants`"))
PY
  show_diff
  run "E5d-acceptance" $ACC

  hdr "E5e 경계 — 판정 문서 첫 줄 'VERDICT: PASSED' / 판정 문서 2개(0000=PASS, 2026=FAIL)"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASSED"
  run "E5e1-acceptance-PASSED" $ACC
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  printf 'VERDICT: FAIL\n\n실제 판정(합성).\n' > docs/engineering/humansearch-kickoff-ledger-verdict-2026-09-10.md
  run "E5e2-acceptance-two-docs" bash -c "$ACC | grep -E '판정 문서|CHECKED|OK\\(|FAIL\\('"
  reset_clone; : > "$FIX"
  run "E5e3-acceptance-empty-doc" bash -c "$ACC | grep -E '판정 문서|CHECKED|OK\\(|FAIL\\('"
fi

if [ "$PART" = "all" ] || [ "$PART" = "E" ]; then
  hdr "E6 경계 — 0개 대상: run-acceptance 에 CHECKED: 0 / 판정 없음 / steps 0개 / 변이 대상 없음"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\necho "PASS: x"\necho "CHECKED: 0"\nexit 0\n' > /tmp/v1-zero.sh
  run "E6-run-acceptance-checked0" bash scripts/verify/run-acceptance.sh /tmp/v1-zero.sh
  printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexit 0\n' > /tmp/v1-silent.sh
  run "E6-run-acceptance-silent" bash scripts/verify/run-acceptance.sh /tmp/v1-silent.sh
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(".github/workflows/verify.yml"); s=p.read_text()
i=s.index("    steps:\n")+len("    steps:\n")
p.write_text(s[:i])
PY
  show_diff | head -5
  run "E6-acceptance-steps0" bash -c "$ACC | grep -E 'FAIL|CHECKED'"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  rm scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh
  run "E6-mutations-target-missing" $MUT
  hdr "E6 경계 — 파일 600/601·함수 100 (AST 직접 재계산)"
  reset_clone
  run "E6-budget" python3 - <<'PY'
import ast,pathlib
for f in ("scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh","scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh","scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py"):
    n=len(pathlib.Path(f).read_text().splitlines()); print(f, n, "OK<=600" if n<=600 else "OVER600")
t=ast.parse(pathlib.Path("scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py").read_text())
for fn in [x for x in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef)]:
    L=fn.end_lineno-fn.lineno+1; print("func",fn.name,L,"OK<=100" if L<=100 else "OVER100", "soft60-exceeded" if L>60 else "")
PY
  hdr "E7 HS-00.02 부채 — 같은 기대 사유 문자열이 다른 원인에도 붙는지"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(".github/workflows/verify.yml"); s=p.read_text()
old="        run: bash scripts/verify/run-acceptance.sh scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh"
p.write_text(s.replace(old,"\t"+old.strip()))
PY
  run "E7-tab-reason" bash -c "$ACC | grep -E '^FAIL'"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(".github/workflows/verify.yml"); s=p.read_text()
old="        run: bash scripts/verify/run-acceptance.sh scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh"
p.write_text(s.replace(old,'        run: printf "검사생략\\n"'))
PY
  run "E7-cmd-reason" bash -c "$ACC | grep -E '^FAIL'"
  reset_clone
fi

# ── PART F: 최소 수정 시제품(검증자 실험, clone 전용) — 최상위 키·스텝 키 화이트리스트 ──
if [ "$PART" = "F" ]; then
  hdr "F 최소 수정 시제품 — list-workflow-steps.py 에 최상위 키·스텝 키 화이트리스트(약 8줄)"
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path("scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py"); s=p.read_text()
a='WEAK_KEYS = ("if", "continue-on-error")\n'
assert s.count(a)==1
s=s.replace(a, a+'TOP_KEYS = ("name", "on", "permissions", "jobs")\nSTEP_KEYS = ("name", "id", "uses", "with", "run", "timeout-minutes") + WEAK_KEYS\n')
b='    jobs = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("jobs:")]\n'
assert s.count(b)==1
s=s.replace(b, '    for i, l in enumerate(lines, 1):\n        if re.match(r"^[^\\s#]", l) and l.split(":", 1)[0] not in TOP_KEYS:\n            return fail("최상위 키 %r (%d행). defaults·env 로 모든 스텝의 실행을 바꿀 수 있다" % (l.split(":", 1)[0], i))\n'+b)
c='        key = body.split(":", 1)[0]\n'
assert s.count(c)==1
s=s.replace(c, c+'        if key not in STEP_KEYS:\n            return fail("스텝 키 %r (%d행). shell·env·working-directory 는 실행을 바꾼다" % (key, i + 1))\n')
p.write_text(s)
PY
  git -C "$CLONE" --no-pager diff scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py
  git -C "$CLONE" add scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py
  git -C "$CLONE" -c user.name=v1 -c user.email=v1@local commit -q -m "V1 시제품: 키 화이트리스트" 
  run "F-ast" python3 -c 'import ast,pathlib
t=ast.parse(pathlib.Path("scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py").read_text())
print([(n.name,n.end_lineno-n.lineno+1) for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)]); print("lines",len(pathlib.Path("scripts/verify/list-workflow-steps.py").read_text().splitlines()))'
  run "F-control-acceptance" bash -c "$ACC | tail -3"
  for m in shell defaults env; do
    reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
    case $m in
      shell) python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(".github/workflows/verify.yml"); s=p.read_text()
old="        run: bash scripts/verify/run-acceptance.sh scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh"
p.write_text(s.replace(old, '        shell: bash -c "true" {0}\n'+old))
PY
      ;;
      defaults) python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(".github/workflows/verify.yml"); s=p.read_text()
p.write_text(s.replace("jobs:\n", "defaults:\n  run:\n    shell: cat\n\njobs:\n",1))
PY
      ;;
      env) python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(".github/workflows/verify.yml"); s=p.read_text()
old="        run: bash scripts/verify/run-acceptance.sh scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff.sh"
p.write_text(s.replace(old, '        env:\n          BASH_ENV: scripts/v1-bait-env.sh\n'+old))
PY
      ;;
    esac
    run "F-neg-$m" bash -c "$ACC | grep -E '^FAIL|CHECKED'"
  done
  reset_clone; fixture "VERDICT: PASS"
  run "F-mutations-37" bash -c "$MUT | grep -vE '^PASS: (음성|양성)[0-9]* '"
  git -C "$CLONE" reset -q --hard HEAD~1
fi
